shared_elements: incised/carved marks on a rock surface
rows of repeated small vertical strokes
justification: A shows dense horizontal registers of small repeated script-like signs covering a dressed wall, while B shows large schematic boats with upcurved spiral-ended prows, crew strokes and a standing figure; the only real correspondence is the presence of rows of repeated short vertical marks, which in A are writing and in B are crew-lines on a hull. There is no shared figurative motif, no shared relationship between elements, and the scale and organisation of the two schemes are entirely different.
